verdict.rationale: Formant is an API-driven fleet platform, so issuing scoped credentials is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows a generic bearer-JWT security scheme on the admin API, with nothing about scoped tokens, service accounts, role-limited keys or least-privilege permission settings. Generic 'governed platform' marketing and the Formant 'agent' (on-device robot software) are not scoped API credentials for an AI agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
